app.title: Nimony: A New Compiler for Nim
app.description: A new Nim compiler implementation written in Nim, focusing on speed and modern tooling.
proposed_tests: Install nimony via 'nimble install nimony' and compile a simple 'Hello, World!' program
Run 'nimony -O2 -o=output hello.nim' and measure compilation time vs official Nim compiler
Compile a large Nim project (e.g., a Nim web server) and compare binary size and startup latency
